row.evidence: Revenue.io's support site says "Revenue.io Admins can easily manage which users in their Salesforce Org have access to the platform" and that the platform "utilizes Salesforce OAuth to authenticate your login"; no SCIM endpoint is documented on the pricing, security or support pages.
row.notes: New row. Revenue.io (formerly ringDNA) is a Salesforce-native sales platform sold in three quote-only plans (Activate, Engage, Orchestrate), 'Built for Salesforce teams of 15+ seats'; no prices are published. There is no direct SAML/OIDC SSO with the customer's IdP: users sign in with Salesforce OAuth, which can redirect to whatever SSO the customer's Salesforce org uses, so sso_plan is null. Users are added by picking them from the connected Salesforce org in the Admin Console and assigning product licences; no SCIM, no JIT and no public user-management API are documented. Okta and Entra have no Revenue.io or ringDNA catalogue app (404). 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Activate
plans.notes: Salesforce OAuth login on all plans; no SAML/SCIM listed.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere on revenue.io or in the support site (1,475-URL sitemap has no SCIM, provisioning, Okta, SAML or Entra article). Users are picked from the customer's Salesforce org in the Admin Console and sign in with Salesforce OAuth. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: No public user-management API is documented. The only documented APIs are Guided Selling automation interfaces inside Salesforce (Flow/Apex) for sequences, not users.

entra.notes: Not listed: learn.microsoft.com ringdna-tutorial and revenue-io-tutorial return 404.

fallbacks.other_sync: Users are imported by selecting them from the connected Salesforce org in the Revenue.io Admin Console (manual pick, not automatic sync).
fallbacks.notes: Login is Salesforce OAuth; customer SSO applies only through the customer's own Salesforce org configuration.
